_comment: Art pass 2026-10-02, batch V: one coherent first-person set with idle and fire frames.
Plan: docs/plans/art-pass-20261002.md. Idles are edits of the 2026-09-19 raw idles so the
camera and framing hold; the first approved idle's gloves are the second reference for the
rest. Each fire frame is an edit of its own approved idle, the only reference.
image_urls are temporary uploads recorded in art/raw/art-pass-20261002/references.jsonl.
Each upload:<file> stood for a temporary provider URL of that local keeper. To rerun, upload the keeper with fragr-spritegen upload and substitute its public URL.
style: redraw this exact first person pixel art weapon sprite from a 1990s PC shooter as the same picture, keeping the identical camera angle, framing, scale, weapon position, silhouette, proportions and chunky stepped pixel clusters, limited palette of desaturated gunmetal grey, rust, bone white and deep shadow with clear value contrast between light steel edge highlights, the mid gunmetal body and dark recesses, flat even lighting
technical: the whole background is one flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF colour with no checkerboard, no pattern, no gradient and no shadow on it, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border

frames.subject: make only these changes: both hands wear worn warm brown leather full-finger work gloves with stitched seams and dark rust-brown jacket cuffs at the wrists, and every round emblem or crest becomes a plain riveted steel plate

edit the first reference picture and keep its rifle exactly as it is; make only these changes: both hands wear the same worn warm brown leather full-finger work gloves with stitched seams and dark rust-brown jacket cuffs at the wrists as the second reference picture, and any round emblem becomes a plain riveted steel plate

edit the first reference picture and keep its double barrel pump shotgun exactly as it is; make only these changes: both hands wear the same worn warm brown leather full-finger work gloves with stitched seams and dark rust-brown jacket cuffs at the wrists as the second reference picture, and the winged emblem on the receiver plate becomes plain stamped rows of rivets with no emblem, no skull and no wings
